name: Native Renormalization and Spectral Matching Protocol
status: formal matching protocol, not a new force law
steps: compute readable residues for every hidden eigenmode
match inherited readable coefficients at mu0
integrate out modes as the scale crosses each threshold
run inherited beta functions plus calculable hidden contributions
compute parameter-map rank and null relations
prediction_rule: a quantity counts as predicted only if it was not used in matching or native-parameter calibration
